heard: A tiny dwarf galaxy is having a massive growth spurt. William Herschel spotted NGC 4449 and saw a total mess. It has no spiral arms, just a chaotic, irregular shape. But astronomers also found vibrant pink clouds of glowing gas. These clouds are intense nurseries, creating massive waves of stars. They even spotted huge clusters of young blue-white stars. The clue to this chaos was hiding in the neighbors. A gravitational tug-of-war with nearby galaxies ignited this starburst. Now, this tiny dwarf galaxy is having a massive growth spurt.
